$description: Document heights the clone's own specs (specs/SPEC_*.md, CLONE_SPEC.md) recorded on the LIVE site, per route and width. extraction/measure_spec_crosscheck.mjs records what the clone renders today next to them (measured-values.json specCrossCheck); verify_all.py check 18 compares the two. This is a cross-check of recorded numbers, not a visual parity measurement: there is no live-site capture pipeline here, and the clone's long text pages use placeholder prose, so differences on those routes are expected and must be explained.
